layouts.name: Fontana Raceway Infield Course
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Infield western hooked return, Infield inner hairpin alternative, Infield northern return alternative. Shared sections count once in the mapped branch length. Branch identity and historical alignment still need review.

layouts.name: Infield western hooked return
layouts.description: The supplied infield entry depicts its physical configuration set: the western hooked return and S, the northern rectangular alternatives, parallel northern straight sections and eastern inner hairpin. The organizer distinguishes the interior test circuit from the auto and motorcycle competition courses. Independently georeferenced public-domain 2022 NAIP imagery confirms these paved branches. Complementary exact pinned 2018 public-node cycles retain the infield footprint, excluding the outer oval, oval pit lane, dragway, paddock access and eastern oval transition. The unique branch distance is not a timed lap; descriptive component names do not claim official configurations. Exact historical timed branch choice remains draft. This component retains the western hooked return.
